font_check: All fonts embedded; Type 1 or CID TrueType; no Type 3 bitmap fonts.

visual_review.method: All final page images visually inspected in four contact sheets; detailed page review during layout iterations.
visual_review.outcome: No observed clipping, overlap, missing glyphs or illegible tables; cover, table of contents, mathematics, bibliography and appendices checked.

rendered_page_images: QA intermediates excluded from the distributable package.
